experiment.title: Change the mug from red to blue
experiment.question: Keep the mug and scene similar. Which word best describes the change?
experiment.lesson: Difference directions depend on images, normalization and wording. They are exploratory measurements, not guaranteed semantic algebra.
experiment.try: Reverse the pair. Try ‘a blue mug’ and ‘a red mug’ instead of single words.
experiment.sourceLabel: Extension of the CodeEmporium subtraction idea
